title: BloctoTokenStaking (Flow) — frozen BLT staking: 100.7M BLT in staker records is holder- or admin-scoped; $0 unprivileged; sale contract bricked
closed_reasons: every value-moving function is entitlement-gated: Staker.* methods (stake/requestUnstaking/withdrawUnstakedTokens/withdrawRewardedTokens) require StakerEntitlement and operate on self.id only; the only Staker resource lives as a private field inside the holder's BloctoPass NFT

BloctoPass.NFT private staking methods require BloctoPassPrivateEntitlement; Collection.borrowBloctoPassPrivate requires CollectionPrivateEntitlement, obtainable only by the account that owns the collection storage (fresh-attacker checker rejections reproduced in PoC C3)

Admin.* methods (addStakerRecord/startNewEpoch/startStakingAuction/endStakingAuction/payRewards/moveTokens/setEpochTokenPayout/createNewAdmin) require AdminEntitlement; the Admin resource sits at /storage/bloctoTokenStakingAdmin in the contract account and NO public capability exposes it (probed: /public/bloctoTokenStakingAdmin absent)

stakingEnabled=false live at block 167,840,658 (frozen): blocks stakeNewTokens/stakeUnstakedTokens/stakeRewardedTokens/requestUnstaking/unstakeAll/addStakerRecord; withdrawUnstakedTokens/withdrawRewardedTokens have no freeze gate but are holder-self-scoped (proven in emulator PoC C2)

the only public write surface, /public/bloctoPassMinter (borrowable &{BloctoPass.MinterPublic}; mintBasicNFT is access(all)), reverts while frozen at BloctoPass.NFT.init -> Admin.addStakerRecord pre-condition ('Cannot register a staker operator if the staking auction isn't in progress'); unfrozen it mints an EMPTY pass (id = totalSupply, all vaults 0) - no theft

contract-account BLT treasury vault (91,708,956.07 BLT) is reachable only through the account's key; /public/bloctoTokenReceiver is an unentitled &BloctoToken.Vault (deposit/read only; withdraw needs FungibleToken.Withdraw entitlement)
BloctoTokenSale (same account) is pre-Cadence-1.0 source ('pub') and cannot load at all - its BLT/tUSDT vaults are unreachable by anyone unless the contract account ships a 1.0 update
no reward-capture path: payRewards mints per named staker ID into that staker's own tokensRewarded bucket with a per-epoch dedup map; no share pool exists
no duplicate-ID/record-replacement path: addStakerRecord is admin+frozen-gated, NFT ids are monotonic from BloctoPass.totalSupply (29,762 = staker count; next id unused)
